name: facilitypulse
description: Live building sensor monitoring dashboard — React + TypeScript UI, Express + TypeScript API

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,ui -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
